title: 礼貌地请求与求助
goal: 会用 Could you ...? / Would you mind ...? 礼貌地请别人帮忙，也会答应或婉拒别人的请求。
tips: 越往后越礼貌：Can you ...? → Could you ...? → Would you mind ...ing?
Would you mind opening the window? 的意思是“你介意开窗吗”，同意要说 No, not at all.（不介意），而不是 Yes。
开口求助先说 Excuse me, sorry to bother you, but ...（打扰一下，不好意思……）

exchanges.hear: Could you do me a favor?
Would you mind closing the window?
Can I borrow your pen for a second?
Could you help me carry these boxes upstairs?
exchanges.hearZh: 能帮我把这些箱子搬上楼吗？
exchanges.reply: I'd love to help, but I'm afraid I hurt my back.
exchanges.replyZh: 我很想帮忙，可惜我背受伤了。

exchanges.hear: Excuse me, sorry to bother you. Could you show me how to use this machine?
exchanges.hearZh: 打扰一下，不好意思。能教我怎么用这台机器吗？
exchanges.reply: Of course. First, put your card here.

exchanges.hear: Would you mind turning the music down a little?
exchanges.hearZh: 你介意把音乐调小一点吗？

exchanges.hear: Could you lend me fifty dollars until Friday?
exchanges.hearZh: 能借我五十美元吗？周五还你。

exchanges.hear: Thanks so much for your help.
exchanges.reply: Anytime. I'm glad I could help.
exchanges.replyZh: 随时，能帮上忙我很高兴。

lines.en: Hi, sorry to bother you. Could you do me a favor?
lines.zh: 你好，不好意思打扰。能帮我个忙吗？

lines.en: I'm going away for the weekend. Would you mind watering my plants?
lines.zh: 我周末要出门，你介意帮我浇浇花吗？

lines.en: Not at all. How often do they need water?
Just once, on Saturday. I'll leave the key with you.
lines.zh: 星期六浇一次就行。我把钥匙留给你。

lines.en: Could you also take in my mail?
lines.zh: 能顺便帮我收一下信吗？

lines.en: Of course. Have a great trip!
Thank you so much. I really appreciate it.
